title: The Congiuntivo Presente
subtitle: parli, creda, dorma. Mood of doubt, wish, subordinate clauses.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This lesson covers the congiuntivo presente. Italian grammar builds on patterns you have already learned. Focus on recognizing forms in context before producing them.

sections.heading: From Italian literature
sections.body: Real examples from Dante, Petrarch, Boccaccio, Machiavelli, Leopardi, or Manzoni illustrate this grammatical point in living use.
